reviewerExecution: No admission helper, tests, staging or repository mutation by reviewer. Root application was observed during review.

finding.description: Path.absolute retains parent traversal and does not resolve symlink ancestors. Lexical report containment plus only immediate-parent symlink checking is not a general outside-repository guarantee.
finding.rootCallCondition: Use only the fixed application.json path; before invocation require resolve()==supplied absolute path, reject every symlink ancestor, require outside-repository containment and nonexistence.

limitations: No generalized helper approval for arbitrary report arguments.
Cleanup is fail closed but not a transaction: incomplete or changed new files may remain on an exceptional failure and must not be overwritten automatically.
No independent reapproval of every historical review conclusion or complete private-content audit.
No browser/native/product/packaging/publication PASS follows from copying review evidence.
